newsitem.title: USA: CapMAC sees Q1 EPS at $0.30 to $0.33/shr.
newsitem.headline: CapMAC sees Q1 EPS at $0.30 to $0.33/shr.

text.p: CapMAC Holdings Inc on Thursday said its first-quarter operating earnings would range between $0.30 and $0.33 per share on a fully diluted basis.
The company in a statement said its expected results were "lower than some expectations and less than the prior year's first quarter."
The company said the results came on lower advisory and other fees for the quarter.

The company also said it expected to take a non-operating charge of between $3.5 million and $4.0 million to its earnings to write down its remaining $9.0 million investment in TMG Group. The write-off will be partially offset by $2 million of securities gains realized on the company's portfolio, the company said.
TMG Group is derivatives subsidiary of the Mutual Life Group of Canada. CapMac Holdings is minority investor in TMG.
The net effect will reduce the company's first-quarter fully diluted non-operating earnings by about $0.06 per share, the company said.
